source.title: NECA Manual of Labor Units 2015-2016 Edition

units.C: per 100 items or per 100 linear feet

conventions.scopeRule: Labor units in this manual are for new work only and for a complete electrical installation. For remodeling or change order situations these labor units need to be substantially increased.
conventions.conditionRule: Labor units are based on NEW material and de-energized conditions.
